title: Al Día
subtitle: Rent that updates and collects itself, in pesos
kicker: Agents on Open Rails · Celo mainnet
end_lines: No independent users yet: every payment shown is our own test

segments.subtitle: Small landlords in Argentina adjust the rent by hand

segments.caption: Find the index, do the sum, message the tenant, watch the bank app, write the receipt, buy dollars. Every month.
The calculator is free and needs no wallet. IPC comes from INDEC and ICL from the BCRA, cross-checked: if the sources disagree, the agent issues nothing.
The PDF is read on the phone. DNI, CUIT, CBU, mail and phone are removed before any text leaves it.
A paid model call over x402, through buy, finds the amount, dates and index. The landlord confirms each field.
The landlord chooses how much stays in pesos and how much becomes dollars. The fee is 0.3%.
One link for the tenant, by WhatsApp. Notices go out by Telegram. This lease is one of our own tests, and the page says so.
The tenant sees the amount, why, and the official source. Another paid call audited this increase against the contract's clause.
Paying opens Ripio: a normal transfer that arrives as wARS at this lease's own address. In this demo we paid wARS ourselves.
Firm Textile quote with the lease contract as taker, compared with Uniswap, settled in one tagged transaction. It can pay only the landlord.
The receipt shows the rate, the fee and both transactions, plus a hash that matches the onchain event.
Zero independent users so far. All volume is our own tests, and the site separates the two.
Second entry, Textile FX: a Stitch fork that prices the taker. Four wallets are 99.5% of wARS fills, and makers lost 2.7 bp to them.
